headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 2, 2026**
article:
The Toronto Blue Jays fell to the Baltimore Orioles in a 5-9 showdown, with Colton Cowser leading the Orioles' offense. The Washington Nationals took down the San Diego Padres 2-4, with Zack Littell earning the win. The Pittsburgh Pirates dominated the Minnesota Twins, securing a 9-3 victory.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Welinton Herrera, who was transferred to the 60-day injured list due to left elbow inflammation. Chris Martin was placed on the 15-day injured list with a right shoulder impingement. Griffin Conine was transferred to the 60-day injured list with a left hamstring strain, while Andrew Nardi was also transferred to the 60-day injured list with a left rib cage stress reaction.

The Detroit Tigers traded Connor Seabold to the Toronto Blue Jays for Juanmi Vasquez. The Colorado Rockies traded Carson Palmquist to the Washington Nationals for cash, and Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies for future considerations.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Fall to Orioles in 5-9 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays suffered a 5-9 loss to the Baltimore Orioles, with the Orioles taking the win. Colton Cowser led the Orioles' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run, 4-RBI performance.

top_news.title: **Padres Fall to Nationals in 2-4 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals took down the San Diego Padres 2-4, with Zack Littell earning the win after 6.0 innings of work. James Wood led the Nationals' offense with a home run and 2 RBI.

top_news.title: **Pirates Cruise Past Twins 9-3**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates dominated the Minnesota Twins, securing a 9-3 victory. Brooks Lee led the Twins' offense with two home runs and three RBIs, but it wasn't enough to overcome the Pirates' strong performance.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Rout Guardians 9-4**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox secured a decisive 9-4 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Jovani Morán earning the win. Jarren Duran led the Red Sox offense with a home run, one RBI, and a 1-for-3 batting line.

top_news.title: **Tigers Walk Off in Thrilling 10-9 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers edged out the Tampa Bay Rays in a high-scoring matchup, with multiple players contributing to the winning effort. Dillon Dingler, Kerry Carpenter, and Riley Greene were among the key hitters for the Tigers, while Yandy Díaz and Junior Caminero led the Rays' offense.

top_news.title: **Marlins Take Down Nationals 7-3**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured a 7-3 victory over the Washington Nationals, led by strong performances from several impact hitters. Griffin Conine, Andrew Nardi, and Josh Ekness, all of the Marlins, contributed to the team's win.

top_news.title: **Rockies' Welinton Herrera Shifted to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Welinton Herrera, a left-handed pitcher for the Colorado Rockies, has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to left elbow inflammation.

top_news.title: **Tigers Acquire Lefty Pitcher in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers made a move on May 27, 2026, acquiring left-handed pitcher Juanmi Vasquez from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for right-handed pitcher Connor Seabold.
